data.one_liner: Retrieve and modify iOS native Settings bundle preferences from Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The plugin provides a simple API to get and set values stored in the iOS system-provided Settings app via a Settings bundle. It also allows listening to settings value changes via a stream.
use_when: You need to integrate your Flutter app preferences with the system-provided iOS Settings app
You want to listen to changes made to native iOS settings values at runtime
avoid_when: You are building for Android or non-iOS platforms (the plugin supports iOS only)
You just need cross-platform key-value local storage without native iOS Settings app integration
strengths: Enables seamless integration with iOS system Settings bundles
Provides a simple API for getting, setting, and listening to preference changes
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of a Settings.bundle in Xcode
data.setup_notes: Requires creating and modifying a Settings.bundle template in your Xcode project under iOS resources.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you need cross-platform simple key-value storage rather than native iOS Settings app integration.

data.minimal_example:
final bool? isDarkMode = await SettingsBundle().get<bool>('theme_mode');
await SettingsBundle().set('theme_mode', true);
